metadata.coverage_preamble: Today holds the York mark, Daniel's own third book, the road to the Theatre and Titus, the half-full buckets, and the house shut west of the Stocks.

yesterday: York is begun where the margin said angry. The messenger is still a mark. The three sheets of the deposing are still on the board.
Daniel's third book is the copy you already own.

Alse saw the churchyard at noon, and she heard the armourers' shops and Ludgate on the way home. Mistress Ansell shut the house, lodger included, to anything west of the Stocks for the rest of the month.
The loaf is still a thumb short of the notch, and still a penny. The window line is one blade.
